crime: "Nobody but you plays it," her father said, and he left her piano behind in the emptied house. "What only you love, you carry alone."

In the prison, one girl sang in the shower room every evening with her back against the door. She let only {WITCH_NAME} in; to everyone else, a door that wouldn't budge meant she was singing. While she sang, {WITCH_NAME} tapped out the piano part on the wet tiles, music she had never told anyone about.
One evening, as the song ended, the singer said, "Stop tapping and just sing along. I never hear it over the water."

{WITCH_NAME} took the towel she handed her after every song, wound it around the singer's throat and twisted until she was still. Then she pulled the door shut behind her and, with a touch, made it too heavy to move, so it held as though the girl were still singing against it. She went to the lounge and sat among the others until lockup.

Ten minutes before lockup, a prisoner tried the shower-room door, found it wouldn't budge, and wedged a note in its seam: "Lockup in ten minutes." She went down to the cells sure the singer was still singing.
At the dawn unlock, with that prisoner beside her, {WITCH_NAME} laid her palm on the door and pushed it open. The singer lay dead on the tiles, the towel at her throat.

In the trial court, the prisoners ruled that she had been killed after ten to lockup, by someone she let in while {WITCH_NAME} sat with them in the lounge. Then the prisoner unfolded the note that had fallen from the door at dawn. It was her own. The prisoners realized that no one had opened that door all night. It had held itself shut by {WITCH_NAME}'s Magic.
fields.epitaph: She could carry anything alone, except a song: the one load that needs someone at the other end.
fields.epithet: The girl who left her piano behind
execution: The execution stand raises an open iron grand piano, bolted to its floor, and she lies chained on her back across its strings. Water pours in and fills the case, rising over the strings and then over her face. Every time she kicks, the strings ring beneath the water, drowned out by the pouring. Then the pouring stops, and the piano falls silent. The water lies still over her and the strings.

magic.name: Feather and Anchor
magic.text: She can make anything she touches light as a feather or too heavy to move.
